Planning.title: Plan
Planning.description: Choose a planning approach and see deterministic suggestions grounded in your forecast, budgets, goals and recorded debt.

suggestions.protect-buffer: Protect this remaining cash before committing to new plans.
suggestions.verify-cash: Verify account balances before acting; the forecast is incomplete.
suggestions.missing-income: Monthly income is not recorded, so the benchmark cannot be calculated.
suggestions.fund-goals-first: Prioritize active savings goals before discretionary spending.
suggestions.set-savings-goal: Create a savings goal to make this strategy actionable.
suggestions.prioritize-high-cost-debt: Prioritize the highest-cost debt first; rates are not recorded here, so confirm the order.
suggestions.missing-rate-data: Interest-rate data is not recorded, so avalanche ordering cannot be determined honestly.
suggestions.prioritize-smallest-debt: Prioritize the smallest recorded debt first.
suggestions.fund-goals-after-debt: After debt payments, direct remaining capacity to active goals.
suggestions.fund-sinking-goals: Direct capacity toward active sinking-fund goals.
suggestions.set-sinking-goal: Create a goal for an emergency buffer or known future cost.
suggestions.no-debt-data: No recorded debt supports this strategy yet.
suggestions.review-over-budget: Review categories that are already over their monthly limit.

NetWorth.title: Net Worth & Balance History
NetWorth.subtitle: Track your household net worth across currencies with verified balance observations and explicit historical confidence.
NetWorth.calculationExplanation: Net worth = Observed Assets − Observed Liabilities (strictly per currency, no FX assumptions).
NetWorth.calculationExplanationDetails: Each point in the series evaluates known balances as of that date. If any active account or liability has no observation on or before that date, the point is flagged as incomplete history and unobserved items are explicitly listed rather than assumed to be zero.

empty.title: No balance observations recorded
empty.description: Record your current or historical balances for accounts and liabilities to start building your net worth timeline.

Budgets.title: Budgets
Budgets.description: Plan category limits and compare them with recorded spending.
Budgets.explanation: Spent is the exact sum of non-voided expense transactions in this category, currency and month. Remaining is the limit minus spent; a negative value means over budget.
Budgets.archiveConfirm: Archive this budget? Its history will remain available.

empty.title: No savings goals

explain.title: Deterministic Exact Contribution Calculation
explain.subtitle: Exact BigInt ceiling arithmetic prevents shortfalls caused by decimal rounding.
explain.surplusExplanation: Standard floating-point division often rounds down or loses fractions of minor units (cents/grosze). Our algorithm performs exact integer ceiling division: (remaining + periods - 1) / periods. Over {periods} periods at {periodicAmount} each, you contribute {totalContributions}, producing a safe surplus of {surplus} and guaranteeing that the target amount of {target} is met or exceeded exactly.
